user_query: productivity software like Notion for technical teams

criteria.text: Provides a web-based productivity application for creating and organizing documents, notes, or knowledge workspaces
criteria.rationale: Filters to companies building the same product category as Notion (document/knowledge workspace) rather than generic software vendors.

criteria.text: Targets technical teams or software engineers as a primary user segment
criteria.rationale: Encodes the user's intent for peers that specifically serve engineering/technical workflows instead of general business users.

criteria.text: Supports code-focused authoring features such as code blocks, syntax highlighting, or embedded runnable snippets
criteria.rationale: Distinguishes tools optimized for technical content from generic note-taking or docs apps that lack developer-centric editing capabilities.

criteria.text: Provides structured, database-like building blocks or configurable tables for modelling tasks, issues, or technical metadata
criteria.rationale: Separates offerings that enable structured engineering workflows and project data from simple linear document editors.

criteria.text: Offers integrations or a public API for connecting with developer tools and platforms such as Git repositories, issue trackers, or CI/CD systems
criteria.rationale: Identifies companies that fit into developer toolchains and automation workflows rather than standalone documentation tools.
